Card Q&A.a: There is no target for the attack, so the effect ends without an attack being performed.
Card Q&A.q: What happens to this card's [When Digivolving] effect if my opponent doesn't have any Digimon that can be attacked?

Effect: [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent’s Digimon. Then, this Digimon may attack an opponent's Digimon.
[Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon becomes suspended, gain 1 memory.
